jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us:


**VOALA**


***Helping Our Most Vulnerable Change Their Life Stories***


Volunteers of America is a non\-profit human services organization committed to serving people in need, strengthening families, and building communities. VOALA provides a variety of social services to Los Angeles area communities such as Head Start programs, Upward Bound college prep programs, veterans’ services, homeless shelters, low\-income housing program as well as drug and alcohol rehabilitation. Learn more at www.voala.org.


**PAY RATE:** $65208 \- $68640 Per Year

  

  

**BENEFITS:** VOALA offers competitive medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits.


**JOB SUMMARY AND PURPOSE**


The Project Coordinator is responsible for meeting the program goals, annually. The Program Goals for the participants served by the Project Coordinator are:


* Enroll and complete in a rigorous high school program of study
* Achieve High School graduation
* Improve academic performance on standardized tests, and competitive scores on college entrance exams
* Enrollment in post\-secondary education
* Promote college degree attainment in six years


The Project Coordinator will ensure the annual enrollment goal of 500 participants is met by January of each year


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Supervise, evaluate and recommend staff for hire
* Collect and submit data for the annual preparation and submission of the Annual Performance Report (APR)
* Monitor and document participant academic progress and ensure a plan of action for improvement
* Visit target school and maintain contact with school personnel to develop awareness of program services and report participant’s progress
* Develop and implement a summer enrichment program
* Develop and implement tutoring math program for RSSP participants
* Responsible for meeting recruitment deadline, the assessment of participant needs, and that each student meets the requirements for enrollment in our ETS Program
* Ensure the completion of all program forms, and the appropriate documentation of all services
* Monitor and document participant academic progress and ensure a plan of action for improvement
* Visit target school and maintain contact with school personnel to develop awareness of program services and report participant progress
* Ensure the collaboration with other youth programs in the community
* Maintain accurate program files for participants in the database and file cabinets
* Develop resource educational materials for project use with seminars and workshops
* Administer and interpret project assessment inventories for participants
* Ensure the appropriate number of contacts with participants are made for college preparation, and social/personal development
* Develop and implement a summer enrichment program
* Plan and conduct parent workshops
* Plan and implement college or career tours
* Ensure that the management of participant case load is continuously being documented to reflect the provision of services
* Other duties as required


**ESSENTIAL ABILITY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT**


Ability to work and deal with difficult, uncooperative, and potentially aggressive clients as VOALA serves the neediest of the needy in our programs, which may include clients with homelessness, mental illness, substance abuse, recently released from incarceration, and other challenges.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**


* Services for this position must be provided on\-site. As a result, the position requires incumbents to report to work on\-site each day of active employment.
* Responsible for day\-to\-day Program efforts, providing guidance and supervision for staff, budget oversight, project timelines, and anticipated outcomes; Effectively plans workload of subordinate individuals and programs; budgets, deploys, and organizes resources
* Recruit participants, perform outreach to school and community
* Develop curriculum and conduct workshops/seminars on college and career planning, financial literacy and personal development
* Coordinate tutorial services available at the target school and community, observe effectiveness, make referrals as appropriate
* Plan and supervise group activities and college visits, assist program activities and field trips
* Engage personally with students, prepare and execute intervention plan for poor academic performance, initiate discipline if needed, involve parents, make referrals to outside resources
* Maintain Blumen database on participants, and program schedule; prepare and record weekly evaluations, observing student privacy
* Make regular reports to Director, assist in preparation of Program’s Annual Performance Report
* Other duties as required and may be subject to change


**MANDATED REPORTER**

As service providers to the underprivileged and vulnerable in our community, all employees are considered Mandated Reporters, and must report any instance of physical or sexual abuse to proper authorities.


Qualifications


**REQUIREMENTS:**


* Must be able to pass a fingerprint clearance, background check, including criminal history, personal references, employment and education verifications
* Ability to perform under circumstances of possible emotional stress and conflicts dealing with difficult, uncooperative, and potentially aggressive clients as VOALA serves the neediest of the needy in our programs which may include clients with homelessness, mental\-illness, substance abuse, recently released from incarceration and other challenges.

* Bachelor’s degree required in education, counseling, social work, higher education administration, or an appropriate field related to Project objectives.


**EXPERIENCE:**


* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience assisting with staff supervision; budget management; program development and evaluation, reporting, and compliance with federal regulations.

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!



Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322\-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.



As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.

* Knowledge and Continual Learning: Remain current with constantly evolving financial aid regulations (federal, state, institutional) and emerging trends and best practices in delivering service excellence. Contribute to the overall success of the Financial Aid Office and Enrollment Services through ad\-hoc assignments.

This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.

jobs.title: ALA Shared Housing Program Coordinator VISTA
jobs.description:
ALA's Shared Housing program, established in 1978, has run continuously for 45 years and matched over 2500 individuals in home share arrangements. Shared Housing has been lauded by civic leaders as an effective alternative to traditional affordable housing. The program is intended to match 1\) seniors who own their homes, live alone, and wish to remain in their homes instead of institutionalization (a nursing home) with 2\) low\-income housing seekers (renters) who need affordable rent. Exchanges may be straight rent or a mix of rent plus up to 10 hours a week in light services such as transportation, cooking, or cleaning. Rental arrangements average $700 a month and services arrangements average $200/month plus services. The average duration of each match is 2 years with the longest match at 10\+ years. Our eldest participant, Shirley, who is 105 years old, was featured in Vice News' report about ALA's Shared Housing program. You may find the video here: https://youtu.be/KeIm2zBYRoM?si\=ehr\-OMBkKp9la\_Nm  

  

  

**Member Duties :** 1\) ) Develop Reporting and Evaluation Systems \- Create reporting tools and evaluation processes that measure housing placements, retention, and participant demographics. 2\) Build Sustainable Outreach Infrastructure \- Develop systems and materials to expand outreach capacity with landlords, home providers, and referral partners. Build tools that sustain engagement and increase access to affordable housing options for low\-income residents. 3\) Strengthen Shared Housing Systems and Workflows \- Design and document efficient workflows for intake, matching, and program coordination. Improve data accuracy, streamline communication, and reduce time to\-placement to help more low\-income Angelenos achieve stable housing.
  

  

**Program Benefits :** Training , Relocation Allowance , Choice of Education Award or End of Service Stipend , Living Allowance , Childcare assistance if eligible , Health Coverage\* .

Permits attendance at school during off hours , Permits working at another job during off hours .

Housing , Homelessness , Community Outreach , Elder Care .
  

  

**Skills :**
  

Non\-Profit Management , Public Speaking , General Skills , Team Work , Community Organization .

Key responsibilities include coordinating resident recruitment and interview activities; managing resident onboarding, scheduling, credentialing, licensure, evaluations, examinations, and professional development activities; coordinating conferences, didactic sessions, skills labs, and other educational programs; and maintaining accurate resident and program records across institutional and regulatory systems. The position also supports accreditation activities, program data management, required reporting, program meetings, affiliation agreements, and communications with residents, faculty, affiliated training sites, alumni, and external organizations.
The successful candidate will manage confidential information with discretion and demonstrate strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. The position requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet strict deadlines, work independently, and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. This role is critical to maintaining the efficiency, compliance, and continued success of the surgical residency program while supporting a high\-quality educational experience for residents and faculty.

jobs.title: Tournament Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Classification**: Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt  

**Pay Range**: $22\.00–$24\.00 per hour  

**Schedule**: 40 hours per week, including a required half\-day weekend shift  

  

**ABOUT AMERICAN GOLF**  

American Golf is a trusted leader in golf hospitality, known for elevating the game and the communities around it. We bring deep expertise in golf operations and club culture, paired with a genuine commitment to creating welcoming, memorable experiences for every guest and member.  

  

Our teams take pride in course care, exceptional service, and thoughtful environments that invite people to play, connect, and feel at home. We believe golf is more than a sport, it’s a place where relationships grow, traditions thrive, and everyone is part of the community.  

  

**Job Purpose**  

The Tournament Sales Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for the Tournament Sales Team. This position coordinates tournament details after each golf tournament/golf outing have been contracted through event completion and serves as a key point of communication between clients, Sales, Golf Operations, Food \& Beverage, and golf course teams.
  

  

The ideal candidate is highly organized, computer savvy, detail\-oriented, and familiar with golf operations, golf outings/tournaments, tee times, and tee sheets. Success in this position requires the ability to manage multiple events, contracts, payments, tee sheets, deadlines, and client requests while providing a high level of service in a fast\-paced golf and event environment.  

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Coordinate tournament and group golf details after contracting through event completion.
* Proven ability to accurately manage, process, and track payments while ensuring timely and proper reconciliation.
* Maintain accurate and current event information in Tripleseat, tee sheets and other company systems.
* Track and collect contracts, deposits, payments, guarantees, player counts, deadlines, and required client documentation.
* Maintain tournament calendars and coordinate tournament dates with Golf Operations and course leadership.
* Enter and maintain tournament blocks, tee times, and related information in Tee Sheets, Tripleseat and/or other required systems.
* Review tee sheets and tournament calendars to identify potential scheduling conflicts and communicate concerns to appropriate management.
* Coordinate player lists, pairings, starting times, formats, cart requirements, scoring information, signage, contests, merchandise, food \& beverages and other tournament logistics.
* Communicate tournament requirements and changes to Golf Operations, Food \& Beverage, and other departments involved in event execution.
* Prepare event orders, tournament summaries, client lists, spreadsheets, reports, and other operational documents.
* Maintain organized electronic files and accurate records for tournaments, outings, and group golf events.
* Follow up with clients regarding contracts, deposits, payments, guarantees, player counts, menus, event details, and other outstanding information.
* Assist clients with questions regarding tournament logistics, course policies, timelines, and event requirements.
* Escalate pricing exceptions, unusual client requests, contract changes, or significant operational issues to the appropriate manager.
* Assist with post\-event documentation, billing information, client follow\-up, and recordkeeping.
* Maintain confidentiality of client, company, pricing, contract, and financial information.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the Tournament Sales team as needed.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


  

**GOLF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE**
* Working knowledge of golf course operations and golf terminology strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with golf tournaments, outings, formats, pairings, player counts, cart assignments, contests, scoring, and tournament flow preferred.
* Experience with tee sheets and tee\-time reservation systems, including tee sheet or similar golf management software, strongly preferred.
* Ability to understand how tournament bookings affect daily golf operations and available tee\-time inventory, especially in the public golf sector.
* Previous experience at a golf course, country club, resort, tournament, event, hospitality, or similar environment preferred.


  

**TECHNOLOGY AND ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS**
* Exceptional communication and attention to detail, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple client and team communications effectively in a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong computer and technology skills required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and professional email communication.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including creating and maintaining spreadsheets, sorting, filtering, organizing data, and using basic formulas.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, including preparing and editing contracts, correspondence, and event documents.
* Experience with Tripleseat or similar CRM \-event sales and management software strongly preferred.
* Experience with tee sheet or another golf reservation/booking systems strongly preferred.
* Ability to quickly learn and effectively navigate new software and technology platforms.
* Strong data\-entry, document\-management, and recordkeeping skills.
* Ability to accurately prepare, review, and maintain contracts and detailed event documentation.


  

**QUALIFICATIONS**
* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in business, hospitality, golf management, sales, or a related field preferred.
* Two or more years of administrative, sales support, tournament, event, hospitality, or golf operations experience preferred.
* Golf course or tournament experience strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Tour Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Tour Operations Coordinator will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer and play a key role in the planning and preparation of our events.

This position will be responsible for managing venue and hotel logistics from initial sourcing through final reconciliation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple events simultaneously, confident communicating with hotels and venues, and capable of maintaining accurate budgets, contracts, deadlines, and operational documentation.

Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, financial awareness, and the ability to proactively identify potential issues are essential for success in this role.

**Key ResponsibilitiesVenue Coordination**

* Research, identify, and evaluate potential venues for regional and national events based on event requirements, availability, location, capacity, and budget.
* Manage the venue sourcing and booking process, including inquiries, proposals, negotiations, contract review, date holds, and securing event dates.
* Maintain ongoing communication with venue contacts throughout the planning process to provide event details, schedules, Certificates of Insurance, and other required documentation.
* Request, collect, review, and organize necessary venue documentation, including but not limited to, floorplans, technical specifications, riser charts, power information, security policies, loading information, and venue guidelines.
* Coordinate venue\-related logistics including ballroom and exhibit hall holds, load\-in and load\-out requirements, AV regulations, labor requirements, union guidelines, security, cleaning, HVAC, power, and other operational needs.
* Work closely with the production team, logistics and event directors to gather venue information and assist in the creation and distribution of venue diagrams, info sheets, show documents, and other event materials.
* Maintain accurate venue budgets for each event, including projected costs, contracted costs, deposits, additional expenses, and final actual spend.
* Track projected versus actual event expenses throughout the planning cycle and maintain accurate, up\-to\-date event cost totals.
* Review venue invoices for accuracy, reconcile final charges against contracted rates and approved expenses, and identify billing discrepancies before payment.
* Track important contractual deadlines including deposits, payment schedules, cancellation dates, insurance requirements, and other venue obligations.
* Maintain organized records of venue contracts, proposals, invoices, floorplans, payment schedules, and supporting event documentation.

**Hotel Coordination**

* Research and source hotels capable of accommodating staff, judges, crew, and other traveling team members for each event.
* Request hotel proposals and negotiate group room blocks, room rates, concessions, amenities, complimentary rooms, upgrades, parking, meeting space, and contract terms.
* Maintain ongoing communication with hotel sales and event managers leading up to each event to confirm rooming lists, check\-in arrangements, billing instructions, arrival details, and special requests.
* Coordinate lodging logistics for traveling team members and ensure accurate rooming lists are prepared, updated, and submitted within required deadlines.
* Monitor hotel room block pickup and proactively manage potential attrition, overages, room shortages, and other contractual concerns.
* Track and confirm fulfillment of negotiated hotel concessions including complimentary rooms, credits, upgrades, amenities, parking, meeting space, and other contracted benefits.
* Develop and maintain hotel budgets for each event, including projected room costs, taxes, fees, concessions, and anticipated lodging expenses.
* Track projected lodging costs against actual hotel spend and update totals as rooming needs, rates, and billing details change.
* Track hotel contractual deadlines including rooming list due dates, cutoff dates, deposit requirements, cancellation terms, attrition dates, and payment schedules.
* Review final hotel invoices and folios for accuracy, reconcile charges against contracted rates and approved rooming lists, and identify discrepancies prior to payment.

**Budgeting, Tracking \& Administration**

* Maintain centralized event trackers containing venue and hotel status, contracted costs, projected expenses, actual expenses, payment deadlines, contractual obligations, and outstanding action items.
* Assist with tour\-wide budgeting and forecasting by compiling anticipated venue and hotel expenses across the annual event calendar.
* Coordinate deposits, payment requests, and final billing documentation with the accounting team to ensure payments are submitted accurately and on time.
* Conduct post\-event financial reconciliation and maintain historical venue and hotel cost data to improve budgeting and sourcing decisions for future events.
* Compare historical, projected, and actual event costs to identify trends, cost increases, savings opportunities, and areas requiring additional review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs through negotiations, concessions, alternative sourcing options, and long\-term venue and hotel relationships.
* Maintain organized and accessible records for each event to ensure contracts, financial information, venue documentation, hotel information, and operational materials remain current and complete.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business, Operations, or a related field preferred but not required; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Previous experience in event planning, hospitality, venue sourcing, hotel sales, group travel, touring operations, or event coordination preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewin

jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator, Indirect
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next\-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and low\-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. jobs.description:
Live events are fun.  

  

Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact.  

  

Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization.  

  

Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences.  

  

TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR.  

  

We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers.  

  

**Why Work at TicketManager**  

At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real\-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast\-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun.  

If you’re excited about live events, cutting\-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here.  

  

**The Role**  

TicketManager is hiring an Account Manager (AM) to own and grow a portfolio of customers, primarily consisting of accounts at approximately $2,500 MRR and below. This is a customer\-facing, revenue\-focused role responsible for driving customer engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and long\-term value.  

  

The Account Manager is the **entry point into TicketManager’s Customer Success career path** and provides the foundation for growth into roles such as **Retention Manager, Account Director, Strategic Director, and beyond.** Account Managers will build the customer, product, and commercial expertise needed to take on increasingly complex and strategic accounts as they grow within the organization.  

  

As the primary relationship owner for their assigned book of business, the Account Manager will develop a strong understanding of each customer’s goals, drive adoption of TicketManager’s platform and services, monitor account health, identify opportunities for growth, and ensure customers continue to see measurable value from their partnership with TicketManager.  

  

This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to build a career in Customer Success and account management within a B2B SaaS environment. Success requires strong relationship\-building skills, commercial instincts, organization, curiosity, and the ability to coordinate internal resources to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The Account Manager owns growth and retention within assigned accounts through building strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, understanding each customer’s business needs, and taking a consultative approach to developing effective sales strategies. This role is responsible for developing and executing account plans, expanding customer engagement, identifying new opportunities, and partnering with internal teams to deliver solutions that create value for the customer and profitable growth for TriCore.


Success in this role is measured by account growth, customer retention, relationship quality, pipeline development, customer satisfaction, and conversion of opportunities into profitable business.

jobs.description:
**Company Information**  

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300\+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.  

  

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.  

  

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!


**Job Summary**

  


The Digital Marketing Analyst is responsible for developing and managing the organization's marketing reporting, dashboarding, audience insights, and business intelligence capabilities. This role will support data\-driven decision making across marketing, ticketing, partnerships, ecommerce, and fan engagement initiatives through actionable reporting and performance analysis. This position will oversee marketing dashboards, tracking implementation, audience analysis, and campaign reporting for paid media while helping establish scalable measurement frameworks and insight generation processes. The role will work closely with stakeholders across departments to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and inform strategic decision making.  


**Essential Functions**
* Develop, update, and maintain marketing and business performance dashboards and recurring reports that provide visibility into KPIs, marketing channel performance, campaign effectiveness, and revenue outcomes. Coordinate with Data Analyst on ticketing and business reporting and analysis.
* Partner with internal and external teams to set up, establish and manage tracking infrastructure, tagging standards, and attribution frameworks across digital channels and platforms, including website, ecommerce, and paid campaigns and channels in coordination with Paid Media Manager.
* Analyze fan, customer, and campaign data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights that support organizational objectives.
* Support audience segmentation and reporting frameworks that support lifecycle marketing, personalization, paid media optimization, and fan engagement strategies
* Deliver reporting and insights to stakeholders across marketing, ticketing, partnerships, and other business functions.
* Assist the development of forecasting, pacing, and performance measurement models tied to acquisition, retention, and monetization goals.
* Collaborate with digital product and marketing teams to measure conversion performance, funnel behavior, and user experience optimization initiatives.
* Ensure data integrity, reporting consistency, and measurement accuracy across dashboards, analytics platforms, and business reporting tools.
* Establish and maintain standardized reporting processes, documentation, and business review cadences across departments.
* Stay informed on emerging analytics tools, dashboarding capabilities, and measurement best practices to improve organizational reporting maturity.


**Required Qualifications**


* BA/BS Degree (4\-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, Product or related technical field.
* 2\-4 years Related work experience.
* Experience creating dashboards, reports, and marketing performance analyses that support business decision making.
* Experience working with digital analytics and campaign measurement tools, including tracking and reporting processes.
* Strong experience translating complex data and analytics into actionable business insights, including audience segmentation, lifecycle analysis, performance measurement, and fan engagement strategies that drive revenue outcomes.
* Experience identifying business opportunities, structuring analyses, synthesizing findings, and delivering clear, data\-driven recommendations to cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with marketing, ticketing, partnerships, digital product, and operations teams to align analytics initiatives with commercial and organizational objectives.
* Experience supporting conversion optimization, campaign performance analysis, and customer journey insights across acquisition, retention, upsell, and engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with analytics, visualization, and marketing technology platforms such as GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, CRM/CDP platforms, and digital advertising platforms preferred.
* Experience in sports, media, entertainment, or consumer\-facing digital businesses preferred but not required.
* Must be flexible to respond quickly and positively to shifting demands and opportunities; able to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple, detailed tasks.
* Strong attention to detail, effective follow\-up and follow through required.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present data insights and reporting findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and security principles, with experience handling sensitive and confidential data.
* Experience working with analytics and marketing technology platforms including GA4, Tableau, Looker Studio, Power BI, CRM/CDP platforms, and dashboarding tools.
* Familiarity with tracking, attribution modeling, campaign measurement, and customer journey analytics across digital ecosystems.

**Independent Veterinary Sales Representative – Los Angeles / Southern California**  
**1099 Independent Contractor \| Commission\-Based \| Territory Opportunity**

Alexander International Innovations, LLC is expanding its veterinary sales presence in Southern California and is seeking experienced, relationship\-driven independent sales representatives.

Southern California has one of the largest and most active veterinary markets in the country. We are looking for motivated professionals who understand their local market and are ready to develop a protected territory with significant growth potential.

**About the Opportunity**

You will introduce veterinary hospitals, specialty and emergency practices, general practices, and other animal\-health organizations to I2F®, a patented medical device designed to support more efficient medication preparation, improve vial access, and reduce avoidable medication waste.

This is an independent contractor opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, educating clinical teams, and developing a territory over time. It is especially well suited for an established veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales professional who wants to add an innovative product to their portfolio.

This position begins with a focus on veterinary medicine. As AII expands into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance, established representatives will have the opportunity to grow with the company and represent I2F within eligible human healthcare accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop prospective veterinary accounts within an assigned Los Angeles/Southern California territory
* Conduct in\-person visits with veterinary hospitals and clinical teams
* Present and demonstrate I2F to veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers, pharmacy personnel, and purchasing decision\-makers
* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing customers
* Follow up on product evaluations, questions, and purchasing opportunities
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, visits, and sales activity in the company CRM
* Represent Alexander International Innovations professionally at local conferences, meetings, and networking events when appropriate
* Collaborate with company leadership and other representatives to support market development

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Previous veterinary, medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or business\-to\-business sales experience preferred
* Existing relationships within the veterinary community are strongly preferred
* Comfortable entering veterinary facilities, initiating conversations, and conducting product demonstrations
* Self\-directed, dependable, and able to manage a territory independently
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* Consistent follow\-through and willingness to remain engaged throughout the sales process
* Comfortable using email, video meetings, and a web\-based CRM
* Located in the Los Angeles/Southern California area and able to travel locally within the assigned territory
* Access to reliable transportation

**Compensation**

* 1099 independent contractor position
* Commission\-based compensation with uncapped earning potential
* Increased commission opportunity based on sales performance
* No income ceiling
* Territory growth and recurring customer orders can create meaningful long\-term earning potential

**What We Provide**

* A patented, clinically relevant product with applications across veterinary medicine
* Product education, onboarding, and ongoing sales support
* Demonstration materials and professionally developed marketing resources
* Access to company leadership and clinical experts
* CRM access and territory\-development support
* Opportunities to grow alongside an emerging healthcare innovation company
* Protected territory consideration based on performance and continued activity
* Early\-entry opportunity with a growing healthcare innovation company

**Materials Sales Representative**

Precast Concrete Products — Outbound Business Development

**Location:** Pomona, CA (serving Southern \+ Northern California)

**Job type:** Full\-Time

**Pay:** $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce

We manufacture precast concrete fence and wall systems at our own plants in Pomona and Hollister — and this role owns selling that product as materials: to contractors, fence dealers, GCs, public agencies, and the architects and engineers who write us into their specs. You'll inherit an active book of business and a standing quote pipeline from day one. This is not a cold\-start territory.

**Who We Are**

American Precast Concrete is a vertically integrated manufacturer of precast concrete fence and wall systems, with our own installation division (Concrete Fence Installers). The materials lane you'll own is a standalone revenue engine: customers who buy our panels, posts, and wall systems and install themselves. We control production, which means you can sell with real answers on lead times, custom work, and delivery.

**What You'll Own**

* **The quote engine:** every qualified materials inquiry gets an accurate, complete quote inside our SLA — correct product, quantities, delivery logistics, and terms, with assumptions documented.
* **Pipeline follow\-through:** disciplined follow\-up on every open quote. Nothing ages out because nobody called back.
* **Outbound growth:** build and work a target list of contractors, dealers, GCs, and agencies. Net\-new accounts are a core measure of this seat, not a side activity.
* **A\&E specification selling:** work with architects and engineers to get our products specified on projects — the long game that fills next year's pipeline.
* **The relationship:** own APC material customer relationships end to end, including warranty and service cases through documented resolution.
* **Clean systems:** complete HubSpot records — every deal has a stage, a next step, and a date.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 3\+ years selling construction materials or building products (precast, masonry, aggregates, fencing, lumber, or adjacent) with a track record you can talk through in numbers.
* Can read site plans well enough to take off linear footage, heights, and product types for a quote.
* Disciplined CRM habits — you document because it wins deals, not because someone makes you.
* Valid CA driver's license; comfortable with regular customer and site visits.

**Preferred**

* Precast concrete or concrete masonry product knowledge.
* Existing relationships with SoCal or NorCal contractors, fence dealers, or public agencies.
* Experience selling to or through architects/engineers (specification selling).
* Bilingual English/Spanish.
* HubSpot experience.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce—final structure discussed at offer.
* Company vehicle or allowance for customer and site visits; phone allowance.
* Paid holidays and PTO.
* An active book of business and live quote pipeline from day one.

**How to Apply**

Reply with your resume and 2–3 sentences on the largest materials account or order you personally landed—what you sold, roughly what it was worth, and how you won it. We move fast: phone screen within days, structured interview and a live work sample at our Pomona plant, and decision within the week.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Conduct routine site checks to identify and resolve execution issues.
* Document recurring issues, root causes, and corrective actions to improve operational accuracy and consistency.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail across high\-volume site updates and launches.

  


**Process Improvement**

**What You Bring:**


* 2–4 years of experience in ecommerce operations, catalog operations, digital merchandising, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience working with ecommerce platforms, CMS/PIM systems, product data, bulk uploads, pricing, or promotional workflows.

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator (AIR & Ocean Operations)
jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator (AIR \& Ocean Operations)**Job Description**
===================

**1\. Position Overview**


The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air \& Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.


This position requires hands\-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five\-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**


1\) Planning \& Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations


2\) Port \& Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on\-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.


3\) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).


4\) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on\-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.


5\) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service\-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.


6\) Partner \& Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.


7\) Compliance \& Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned.


8\) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

**3\. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**


1\) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


2\) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands\-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.


3\) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures


4\) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.


5\) Language

* English


6\) Weekend work may be required.


Pay Rate: up to $28\.00 per hour (negotiable)

**Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; paid sick leave; life, accidental death \& dismemberment (AD\&D), and long\-term disability (LTD) insurance; and optional voluntary life/AD\&D coverage. Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

jobs.description:
Turn ambition into influence as an **Entry Level Sales Development Representative** at Clinical Management Consultants, building a high\-growth career where AI recruiting, healthcare sales, technology, marketing, and relationship development converge in downtown San Francisco.


As an Entry Level Sales Development Representative, ambitious professionals can build valuable expertise within Clinical Management Consultants, a modern, technology\-forward healthcare recruiting and staffing organization serving a national market. This opportunity offers exposure to healthcare sales, recruiting, digital marketing, business development, negotiation, client relationships, and AI\-assisted talent acquisition in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment. Through AI\-powered workflows, data\-driven candidate sourcing, modern communication tools, measurable performance goals, and industry\-leading commission potential, each sales associate can expand a professional network while helping build and advance an AI\-first healthcare staffing CRM used to connect healthcare organizations with talented professionals.


The Entry Level Sales Development Representative operates at the center of an energetic, commission\-driven healthcare recruiting and outbound sales environment. Acting as a sales associate, recruiter, and business development representative, this professional will identify prospective candidates, source talent, market career opportunities, cultivate relationships with a professional healthcare audience, engage potential clients, follow up with leads, support negotiations, manage pipelines, and move searches toward successful placements. The role features an **industry\-leading AI\-first Healthcare Staffing CRM**, a **national recruitment marketplace**, **uncapped commissions**, and an **exceptional downtown San Francisco location**. AI\-assisted sourcing, candidate matching, recruiting automation, analytics, digital outreach, and intelligent workflows enhance human judgment and relationship\-building rather than replace them, allowing initiative, persistence, creativity, and measurable results to drive success.


Supported by experienced healthcare recruiters, account executives, recruiting leaders, marketing professionals, and technology\-enabled systems, the Entry Level Sales Development Representative will progressively take on greater responsibility across candidate development, client communication, lead generation, account development, market research, outreach, recruiting strategy, pipeline management, follow\-up, negotiation, relationship management, and placement activity. Practical training and day\-to\-day collaboration will help the business development representative develop transferable capabilities in healthcare staffing, sales, marketing, communication, AI recruiting technology, talent acquisition, and account management. Professionals who consistently produce results, understand healthcare markets, and earn the confidence of clients and candidates can broaden their responsibilities and create a compelling long\-term career trajectory.


The ideal Entry Level Sales Development Representative is ambitious, competitive, personable, articulate, persuasive, resilient, organized, and energized by meeting new people over the phone and through digital channels. Successful candidates will be comfortable pursuing measurable KPIs, balancing multiple priorities, learning new recruiting technology, and exploring how AI can improve sourcing and engagement. For an Entry Level Sales Development Representative, San Francisco, CA, is more than a workplace—it is a launchpad at the intersection of healthcare, AI, entrepreneurship, technology, and sales. jobs.title: PiBnB Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
The PiBnB Logistics Coordinator is responsible for making the physical operations behind PiBnB run smoothly.


This person coordinates the many moving pieces required to get a PiBnB location ready for data collection: bookings, props, transportation, moving services, setup logistics, and ongoing site needs. They also help improve the systems and workflows that allow PiBnB to operate across more locations with less manual coordination.


This is a highly operational role. The ideal person is organized, responsive, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and good at building relationships with a wide range of people.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Bookings \& Site Coordination**

* Coordinate PiBnB bookings and scheduling.
* Communicate with hosts or site contacts before, during, and after bookings.
* Confirm access, timing, site requirements, and any special logistics.
* Maintain clear visibility into upcoming bookings and readiness.

**Props \& Site Readiness**

* Coordinate which props and equipment are needed at each location.
* Ensure props are staged, transported, and available before operations begin.
* Track missing, damaged, or misplaced items.
* Coordinate replenishment or replacement as needed.

**Transportation \& Vans**

* Coordinate vans and transportation required for each PiBnB deployment.
* Make sure vehicles are available at the right times and locations.
* Coordinate loading, unloading, and transportation of equipment and props.

**Moving \& Setup Services**

* Coordinate movers or other external service providers when needed.
* Provide clear instructions and expectations to vendors.
* Ensure locations are set up and reset appropriately.

**Operational Coordination**

* Act as a central point of coordination between operators, PiBnB hosts, vendors, drivers, props teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Identify logistics problems early and resolve them quickly.
* Communicate changes clearly when plans shift.

**Workflow Improvement**

* Build repeatable processes for recurring PiBnB logistics.
* Identify unnecessary manual work and opportunities to simplify coordination.
* Create checklists, trackers, templates, and other lightweight systems.
* Help PiBnB scale from individually coordinated deployments toward a reliable operating system.

**What We're Looking For**


The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

* **Organization:** Can keep many parallel details straight without dropping things.
* **Anticipation:** Thinks ahead about dependencies and potential failure modes.
* **Ownership:** Sees something that needs to happen and drives it to completion.
* **Prioritization:** Can distinguish an urgent blocker from something that can wait.
* **Communication:** Gives clear, concise updates and knows when to escalate.
* **Relationship building:** Works effectively with hosts, vendors, operators, and internal teams.
* **Adaptability:** Stays effective when plans change or unexpected problems arise.
* **Process orientation:** Doesn't just solve today's problem; looks for ways to make the next occurrence easier.
* **Attention to detail:** Checks that things are actually ready rather than assuming they are.
* **Service mindset:** Understands that good logistics makes everyone else's job easier.

The Administrative \& Program Coordinator provides administrative, program, development, and governance support to the Executive Director and contributes to the effective day\-to\-day operation of Riverdale Senior Services (RSS). The position supports contract and grant administration, fundraising activities, Board and committee coordination, transportation services, invoice reconciliation, and general office operations. The Administrative \& Program Coordinator works with senior leadership, Board members, funders, staff, vendors, older adult members, and community partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working independently and collaboratively. Working knowledge of social media, nonprofit operations, and programs serving older adults is preferred. This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

Key Responsibilities1\. Administrative Support

* Provide administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director.
* Assist with the preparation, submission, tracking, monitoring, and compliance of contracts and grants.
* Coordinate monthly staff meetings, including scheduling, agendas, meeting materials, and summaries as requested.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for Board and committee meetings, including scheduling, meeting invitations and reminders, preparation and distribution of agendas and materials, meeting logistics, and maintenance of meeting records. Serve as a liaison among the Executive Director, staff, Board members, and committee chairs to facilitate communication and follow\-up.
* Support the Executive Director and Deputy Director with special projects, research, correspondence, and organizational initiatives.

2\. Development \& Fundraising

* Assist with the coordination and administration of fundraising events, campaigns, and development initiatives.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**
---------------------


Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross\-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.


You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1\.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

**OUR ETHOS**
-------------


Operating at the epicenter of stablecoin innovation means moving fast and thinking globally. Our team reflects the diverse, international audiences we serve. We hire people who stay agile as the tide ebbs and flows, fix what's broken without waiting, chase trends before they peak, and remember to have fun through it all.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


Uptop is one of the fastest\-growing pieces of Rain's platform. Our sports and entertainment partners use our rewards infrastructure to launch loyalty programs that change how their fans spend — combining everyday earn mechanics with merchant\-funded offers and premium redemption experiences that people actually want. Every one of those programs is a complex, cross\-functional launch: program design, offer and merchant supply, technical integration, compliance review, marketing coordination, and a partner team that is often building a loyalty program for the first time.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own that experience end to end. You will be the core interface between Rain and our partners from the moment a deal is signed — driving program design, coordinating launch, and then owning the relationship as the program scales. This is not a ticket\-queue support role. You will run complicated, multi\-month processes across many moving parts, hold the details that no one else is holding, and become the person our partners trust to get things done.


You'll own a portfolio of roughly five enterprise programs, with room to grow to ten as the business scales. This role is based in New York City, reports to the GMs of Rain's rewards business, and works closely with our Product, Engineering, BD, and Compliance teams.

* Lead recurring business reviews: report on program performance, surface insights on spend lift and engagement, and recommend changes that make the program work harder
* Surface expansion opportunities within your accounts and hand them to BD with the context they need to run

* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programs to a deadline, with real ownership of the outcome
* Exceptional attention to detail; you are the person on the team who catches the thing everyone else missed
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, and genuine enjoyment of building relationships with partner teams

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Live events are fun.  

  

Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact.  

  

Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization.  

  

Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences.  

  

TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR.  

  

We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers.  

  

**Why Work at TicketManager**  

At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real\-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast\-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun.  

If you’re excited about live events, cutting\-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here.  

  

**The Role**  

TicketManager is hiring an Account Manager (AM) to own and grow a portfolio of customers, primarily consisting of accounts at approximately $2,500 MRR and below. This is a customer\-facing, revenue\-focused role responsible for driving customer engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and long\-term value.  

  

The Account Manager is the **entry point into TicketManager’s Customer Success career path** and provides the foundation for growth into roles such as **Retention Manager, Account Director, Strategic Director, and beyond.** Account Managers will build the customer, product, and commercial expertise needed to take on increasingly complex and strategic accounts as they grow within the organization.  

  

As the primary relationship owner for their assigned book of business, the Account Manager will develop a strong understanding of each customer’s goals, drive adoption of TicketManager’s platform and services, monitor account health, identify opportunities for growth, and ensure customers continue to see measurable value from their partnership with TicketManager.  

  

This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to build a career in Customer Success and account management within a B2B SaaS environment. Success requires strong relationship\-building skills, commercial instincts, organization, curiosity, and the ability to coordinate internal resources to deliver an exceptional customer experience.  

  

**Responsibilities:*** **Account Ownership \& Customer Success**
	+ Own the day\-to\-day relationship and overall success of an assigned portfolio of customers, primarily consisting of accounts at approximately $2,500 MRR and below.
	+ Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business objectives, TicketManager usage, key stakeholders, and opportunities to deliver greater value.
	+ Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and serve as the primary point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle.
	+ Maintain consistent customer engagement and ensure accounts receive proactive, high\-quality communication and support.
* **Adoption, Retention \& Growth**
	+ Drive adoption and utilization of TicketManager’s products and services across assigned accounts.
	+ Monitor account health, engagement, usage, and customer sentiment to identify potential risks and opportunities early.
	+ Develop and execute action plans to improve engagement, strengthen customer relationships, and increase long\-term value.
	+ Identify upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities across TicketManager’s product portfolio and partner with the appropriate Revenue team members to move opportunities forward.
	+ Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong customer relationships, documenting account health and value, and partnering closely with the Retention team throughout the renewal process.
* **Customer Business Reviews**
	+ Prepare and lead customer business reviews that demonstrate product usage, value delivered, and opportunities to strengthen the partnership.
	+ Use customer data, product usage, and account insights to provide recommendations and identify opportunities for increased adoption and value.
	+ Partner with internal teams to prepare account\-specific materials and ensure follow\-through on commitments and next steps.
* **Cross\-Functional Account Management**
	+ Serve as the internal quarterback for assigned accounts, coordinating across Customer Support, Ticket Operations, Product, Sales, Retention, and other teams as needed.
	+ Proactively identify customer issues or risks, engage the appropriate internal resources, and maintain ownership through resolution.
	+ Ensure internal teams have the customer context and information needed to deliver a consistent experience.
* **Account Planning \& CRM**
	+ Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date account records, customer contacts, activity, opportunities, risks, and next steps.
	+ Develop account plans for priority customers within the assigned portfolio.
