jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, SLED
jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the SLED (State, Local Government and Education) segment. RAM is a field sales position. This role will be responsible for working with CA State Agencies. RAM will execute a Go\-To Market Strategy derived from prospecting and collaborating with SLED Focused Partners to build and maintain a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to continue your selling career. You will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall field sales career path at Fortinet and State experience would be a plus.  



**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory.
* Meet or exceed the required number of face\-to\-face meetings each month with customers and partners in the territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
* Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts, and recognition.
* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations, and quotes in Salesforce.com).
* Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner.
* Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects \& customers.
* Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the Mid\-Market segment.
* Follow up on inbound, web, and corporate event leads.
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentations and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING).
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported.
* Act as a liaison between partners, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members.
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth of our business.
Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.  
* 

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Coachable and flexible.
* 1\+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space, with a preference for experience selling to SLED accounts.
* Working knowledge of the businesses, procurement processes, and partners in the local territory, especially within the SLED sector.
* Ability to run productive customer\-facing and partner\-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow\-up.
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets.
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally.
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota.
* Self\-driven and able to manage a diverse, high\-volume workload.
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment.
* Be computer savvy.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills.
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward\-thinking manner.
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction.
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience selling cybersecurity or technology solutions to State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts.
* Familiarity with government procurement processes, cooperative purchasing agreements, and budget cycles in the SLED sector.
* Public/private cloud experience is a plus.
* Experience with multi\-tier distribution is a plus.
Experience in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud is a plus.  
* 

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $130,000 \- $160,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We're expanding our Customer Success team and seeking an exceptional Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our growing organization and elevate our customer experience. As a CSM at Silna, you’ll work to drive retention, expansion and customer satisfaction while managing our most valuable enterprise relationships. If you're energized by creating impactful processes and have a talent for building lasting customer partnerships, this role is designed for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Management:** You'll be the primary advocate for our enterprise accounts, guiding them from onboarding through their entire customer journey with us. This role combines strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and relationship building.
* **Establish trust and credibility:** Healthcare is built on trust, and you'll be responsible for establishing authentic relationships with our partners.
* **Product Expert:** When customers need insights about Silna's platform, your comprehensive product knowledge will help them maximize value from our solutions.
* **Sales\-forward mindset:** Silna’s existing customer base has myriad routes for expansion. Identifying and executing on expansion opportunities is a core competency for this role.
* **Analytics Specialist:** You'll leverage your analytical mindset to monitor account health and identify trends that drive customer success.
* **Systems Thinker:** You take ownership of our operations, examining processes from end\-to\-end to identify strategic improvements that drive sustainable organizational change.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of experience in Customer Success experience in a high\-growth SaaS company
* 2\+ years managing Enterprise Customers (six figure contracts)
* Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise relationships
* Strong project management skills with experience handling multiple concurrent high\-priority initiatives
* Excellent communication skills \- spiking on the ability to *build relationships* \- with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to work from the Silna office in Manhattan 5 days/week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare technology industry experience
* Experience with complex technical workflows
* Demonstrated success in driving account expansion and upsell opportunities

**The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate**

* Natural relationship\-building abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous situations and create structure where none exists
* Strong initiative and self\-motivation to identify and pursue opportunities independently
* Ability to quickly establish rapport with anyone in a new environment
* Strategic thinking with a focus on driving business outcomes
* Exceptional organizational and multitasking capabilities

**What Sets You Apart**

* You relish the opportunity to take on a new challenge
* You persevere and never give up no matter the situation or likelihood of failure
* You understand what motivates different stakeholders in an organization and quickly identify corporate political paradigms
* You enjoy getting to know strangers and can quickly adapt to any personality type.

**About Silna**
---------------


Healthcare is obsessed with optimizing a broken system. We're making sure it never breaks.


Silna Health attacks the root cause of denied claims: the fragmented, incompatible systems that govern prior authorizations, eligibility verification, and benefit checks, turning workflows that used to take days into decisions made in minutes, before care is ever delivered.


We work across behavioral health, physical health, ambulatory care, and post\-acute care, where administrative failure doesn't just cost money; it can delay or deny patient access entirely. We're backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures, and we're building fast.

**What We Offer**

* A rapid\-paced work environment with an incredibly enthusiastic and motivated team.
* The opportunity to work with customers that ***actually love*** the product.
* The ability to work on a technology that is materially improving health outcomes
* Competitive compensation and benefits package
* 401k
* Unlimited PTO


Compensation Range: $130K \- $185K

jobs.title: SDR
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


**Strategic Growth Partner**


As a Strategic Growth Partner (SGP) at Compass International Holdings, you are the face of the company and the engine of our market expansion, directly responsible for driving net\-new pipeline for our Strategic Growth Team. In its simplest form, you will educate our agent community on the benefits and importance of contributing to the Strategic Growth of Compass International Holdings, identifying who in their network of prospective agents should be introduced to our closing team.


SGPs are the future of the Strategic Growth organization. In addition to the direct impact this role has as a partner to the Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs) in the market, you will ultimately be working toward the goal of becoming an SGM yourself. From onboarding all the way through a formal SGP\-to\-SGM training program, your focus will be on developing the skills and knowledge that line a direct path into a closing sales position within an incredibly driven, high\-performing team.


**What You’ll Do**


* Generate new business opportunities to build a sales pipeline through strategic inbound and outbound efforts.
* Outreach directly to prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold\-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods.
* Articulate our value proposition (technology, marketing, culture, and growth) and handle objections to create qualified opportunities in your market.
* Partner with Agents to identify referral opportunities and seamlessly transition them to a Strategic Growth Manager for full\-cycle closing.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Growth Managers and Team Leaders to develop successful prospecting strategies, adding value to each SGM’s sales process.
* Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow\-up communications.
* Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
* Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.

**What This Role Offers**


* A formal SGP\-to\-SGM training program designed to fast\-track your career into a closing sales position.
* Direct partnership and mentorship from top\-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
* A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
* Operate with a "glass\-half\-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.

**How You’ll Be Measured** This role is measured by pipeline generation and the volume of qualified opportunities successfully created for the Strategic Growth Managers.


**Location** Based in our Manhattan office, this onsite role will have you engaging directly with the local Compass Agent Community and collaborating in person with the Strategic Growth team.


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree with 2\+ years of relevant experience and a history of strong performance (SDR, Customer Success/Service, Direct Sales, Account Management).
* Strong interpersonal and rapport\-building skills; a natural leader with a positive, solutions\-oriented mentality.
* Self\-starter attitude with the ability to exercise judgment, solve difficult problems without direct supervision, and comfortably navigate ambiguity.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to effectively lead client meetings and presentations.
* Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail\-demanding functional responsibilities.

**Compensation** The base pay range for this position is $38\.46–$43\.27 per hour ($80,000–$90,000 annualized); with an annual target bonus of $10K\-$15K and uncapped bonus potential. We provide a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

  



**Perks that You Need to Know About:**


Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele\-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

  

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**
At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.



Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100\+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer\-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.



We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30\-year\-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.



We're a team of 170\+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.


Lithic's Treasury Operations team owns the movement of money across our card issuing infrastructure — network settlement, sponsor bank transfers, and the reconciliation that keeps it all provable. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who wants to learn the inner workings of payments and fintech infrastructure, not just observe them from a reporting layer.



You'll be running a critical, time\-sensitive engine every day — and at the same time, working alongside the Head of Treasury Operations to improve how that engine works as the function scales. You’ll also work cross\-functionally across a wide range of teams (Finance, Treasury Engineering, Risk, Analytics, Processing, Customer Success, Bank Operations) — this role sits at the center of a lot of different workflows, not off in a silo.


**What You'll Do**
------------------



Execution (50%)


* Own day\-to\-day execution of network settlement transfers (Mastercard, Visa) and related treasury transfers across sponsor banks
* Operate in a time\-sensitive environment where errors or delays have immediate downstream consequences
* Support reconciliation and ensure transfers tie out against expected activity
* Be a reliable, detail\-oriented operator of an existing process — accuracy and consistency matter as much as speed


Process Optimization (20%)


* Take existing workflows and make them better: fewer manual steps, stronger controls, cleaner audit trails
* Identify friction or risk in current processes and propose (and build) improvements
* Balance improvement work against the need for strong financial controls — nothing gets streamlined at the expense of auditability


Project Support (30%)


* Support the Head of Treasury Operations on larger initiatives as the function scales
* Contribute analysis, documentation, and execution support to new treasury infrastructure, reporting, or process builds


Ongoing


* Run ad hoc data analysis (SQL, Excel) to answer operational and financial questions on the fly
* Support downstream audit and reporting needs tied to settlement and reconciliation activity
* Be available outside normal business hours in rare emergency situations (e.g., a failed settlement or bank\-side issue)

**What You'll Learn**
---------------------



This role is a front\-row seat to the nuts and bolts of card issuing and payments infrastructure — network settlement mechanics, sponsor bank relationships, and the guts of how money actually moves through a modern fintech stack. You'll come out of this role with a depth of operational fintech knowledge that's hard to get anywhere else.


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 2–4 years of relevant experience in treasury operations, funds transfer/money movement operations, cash management, or a closely adjacent operational finance role
* Experience with reconciliation and financial controls — you understand *why* the numbers need to tie out, not just how to make them tie out
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including comfort with (or willingness to learn) Google Apps Script for automating recurring workflows
* SQL proficiency for querying and validating data (we use Snowflake and Metabase); Python or other scripting is a plus, not a requirement
* Working comprehension of accounting concepts and financial operations / money movement (ACH, wires, card settlement, or similar) — you should be knowledgeable about how transfers and reconciliation tie back to the books
* Familiarity with Jira and Slack, or similar ticketing and collaboration tools, for tracking progress and coordinating across teams
* Comfort shifting flexibly between fixed process workflows and operating in an agile enrivonment (sprints, tickets, iterative process improvement)
* Interest in operating in a fast\-moving startup/fintech environment — this isn't a traditional back\-office treasury seat


The annual US salary range for this role is $80,000 \- $110,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.



This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

### **Benefits for Full\-Time US Employees:**


* Unlimited PTO
* 12\-weeks fully paid parental leave
* 4\-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5\-year anniversary)
* Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4\-weeks each year
* 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account
* Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match
* 401(k) match
* Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD


NYC\-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.



In\-office employees receive:


* Commuter benefit
* Catered lunch every Tuesday

jobs.description:
***Business Impact***

The Product Development team drives the execution of the product development process, ensuring West Elm products are delivered on time and meet our standards for design, quality, value, and customer relevance.


The Sample Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in that process by creating visibility, accuracy, and accountability across the sample lifecycle. This role ensures design and product development teams have the right samples, in the right place, at the right time to support key milestones, reviews, photography, and decision\-making.


***Position Summary***

The Sample Operations Coordinator owns the daily execution of sample receiving, tracking, organization, and reporting across product categories. This role manages the flow of design samples from shipment through receipt, staging, workroom organization, milestone support, and archive rooms.


This is a highly cross\-functional role that partners closely with Product Development, Design, Merchandising and Facilities teams to maintain accurate sample data, improve sample visibility, and support an organized, efficient product development process.  



*Candidate Description*

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and energized by making complex workflows run smoothly. They take pride in creating order, building reliable processes, and helping cross\-functional teams work more efficiently.


This person brings a service mindset, strong follow\-through, and a sense of ownership to every task. They are comfortable working independently, shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment, and using data to track progress, identify issues, and communicate status clearly.


A successful Sample Operations Coordinator is not only accurate and dependable, but also curious about how the process can improve. They are confident working across teams, asking the right questions, and helping create a sample management function that is scalable, visible, and trusted.


*Essential Functions*

* **Sample Process Ownership**  

Own and maintain the sample tracking process across assigned categories, ensuring accurate visibility to sample status from shipment through receipt, staging, and final placement. Partner with Product Development, Design, Facilities, and category teams to align on ship\-to codes, sample shipping details, labeling, receiving expectations, and milestone needs.
* **Sample Receiving \& Data Accuracy**  

Manage the timely receipt, unboxing, identification, and logging of sample shipments. Maintain accurate sample records in tracking systems, including PLM and Airtable.
* **Reporting \& Communication**  

Create and maintain sample reporting standards to provide visibility to shipment status, outstanding issues, and priority needs.
* **Sample Room \& Workroom Organization**  

Partner with Design and Product Development teams to maintain organized and functional sample workrooms. Support process improvements that make samples easier to locate, review, and manage.
* **Milestone, Mock Store \& Photoshoot Support**  

Coordinate sample set\-up for product reviews and photoshoots. Partner with teams to ensure priority samples are available, staged, and ready for review.
* **Shipment Issue Resolution**  

Monitor third\-party shipping issues, lost shipments, delayed deliveries, and sample discrepancies.
* **Process Improvement \& Ownership**  

Identify opportunities to improve sample flow, organization, reporting, and communication. Bring forward ideas that increase efficiency, reduce sample loss, improve visibility, and strengthen Sample Operations as a reliable operational function.
*Qualifications*

* 2\-4 years of experience in Product Development, Operations, Merchandising, Production, Sample Management, or a related field; home goods or retail experience preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Office, especially Excel.
* Experience with Airtable or similar tracking/project management tools preferred.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world's most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50\+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.


The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028\. We're building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you're excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we'd love to meet you.

**About the role…**
-------------------


We're looking for a Business Development Representative who will both personally drive meaningful new pipeline *and* work with the broader team to level up how our entire outbound engine runs. This is a rare blend of individual contribution and process innovation.


You'll carry a personal pipeline target and partner closely across our sales and marketing teams. Together, you will own our top\-of\-funnel strategy and goals. Just as importantly, you'll partner to reinvent how we prospect — bringing an AI\-first mindset to sourcing, research, messaging, and workflow so that our small team punches well above its weight. This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing \& RevOps and is fully remote, if located in Austin \- we would expect you to come into our local coworking space 2 days a week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


This is the top of Archive's revenue engine. Every new logo we win — Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance — started with someone opening the door. That's this role.

* **Own the number.** You'll carry a personal pipeline generation target and be jointly accountable with the team for the net new number overall — forecasting opportunity creation, calling it accurately, and keeping the team on pace.
* **Build relationships with world\-class brands.** You'll research, account plan, and open opportunities with an elite list of household names. We value depth over breadth: roughly 30 accounts a quarter, worked properly, beats a thousand sprayed sequences.
* **Rebuild how we prospect, with AI.** This is the half of the job that compounds. You'll use AI and LLMs to redesign how we source, research, prioritize, personalize, and sequence — testing, iterating, and doubling down on what works. The goal isn't efficiency, it's leverage: a motion where you and the team put out the quality *and* the volume of a 3\+ person BDR team, without losing the craft that makes outreach actually convert.
* **Own the data and inform the stack.** Everything tracked, documented, and flowing cleanly between tools. You'll demo new tools and make the call on what we add, consolidate, or cut. There are more tools than ever before, but the real magic is in your ability to creatively leverage these tools and know when to just show up as a human.
* **Partner across the go\-to\-market team.** You'll work directly with the sales and marketing team as well as partnering with other teams across the org— refining the end\-to\-end sales process, building the prospecting workflow, and making sure the outreach engine is aimed at the right brands and capturing the right signals.
* **Build momentum.** You'll help shape our sales norms as the team grows, and take on — or invent — the projects that help Archive grow. It's normal to have never built a motion like this before, you won’t be building it alone and we care more that you want to.

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 1\-2\+ years of sales development / outbound experience
* You've personally been a top\-performing BDR/SDR and still love the craft of opening opportunities — you take pride in crafting campaigns and writing emails that convert.
* You have strong writing skills and can generate compelling, high\-converting sales emails.
* You’re collaborative and want to be part of an excellent team, hold yourself and others to high standards, and are looking for the right role to advance your career.
* You're AI\-native. You don't just use ChatGPT to draft emails — you think in systems, and you have a strong point of view on how AI can be woven through the entire outreach landscape to make a tiny team output like a much larger one. You're excited to dig deeper and learn how to optimize with AI.
* You're proficient with sales and automation tools like HubSpot and Apollo, and you believe in continuous process improvement.
* You have a competitive nature and a growth mindset, and are willing to do hard things, viewing challenges as opportunities for development. Presenting in front of executives, cold calling, knocking on doors, finding the right way to get in front of the right people.
* You're organized and data\-driven, comfortable owning a number.
* You care about sustainability and believe in the power of secondhand shopping to transform the industry.
* Ideally you are in Austin and excited to be in person in our coworking space 2\+ days a week.

**Bonus requirements**
----------------------

* Events experience (in\-person networking)
* Writing experience (blogs, content, etc)

**The expected annual base salary range for this position is $60K\- $80K, USD, plus additional variable compensation through an On\-Target Earnings (OTE) structure.** Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren't limited to) such as role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible for equity as well, and all employees are eligible for a full benefits package including employee and dependent healthcare and 401(k) enrollment.

This is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused position that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Starting Your Day**
---------------------


You begin your morning by reviewing project schedules, production updates, installation timelines, and customer communications. With several projects in different stages of production, you prioritize your workload and identify any issues that require immediate attention.


You check emails, review artwork approvals, monitor shipping schedules, and prepare for customer meetings. Every day starts with a clear understanding of what needs to happen to keep projects moving forward.

-----------------------------------


Throughout the day, you communicate with customers, exhibit houses, marketing teams, event coordinators, and internal departments to ensure everyone is aligned.


You answer questions, provide project updates, review specifications, coordinate schedules, and help customers navigate changes throughout the project lifecycle.

Daily communication and teamwork are essential to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

-------------------


While providing outstanding customer service, you also look for opportunities to grow customer relationships.


You identify additional products and services that support your clients' marketing objectives and event needs while helping build long\-term partnerships.

Before ending the day, you update project notes, document customer communications, confirm production milestones, and prepare for the next day's priorities.

jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
* Peachtree Corners, GA, United States / Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Specialist to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in either our Sunnyvale, CA or Peachtree Corners, GA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process auto

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
As a Sales Development Representative you will be a key contributor to our enterprise wide sales initiative. We are looking for someone with a proven track record and hunger for success in our industry. The goal is to drive sustainable financial growth through boosting sales and forging lasting relationships with our customers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* As the Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will take ownership of nurturing and cultivating relationships with our prospects throughout their entire journey, from initial contact to post\-sale support. Your pivotal role involves creating a well\-structured sales funnel through proactive prospecting, ensuring a steady flow of activity and opportunities for our sales team.
* Employ various strategies to generate appointments and drive traffic by meeting departmental activity targets utilizing outbound calls, online inquiries, and other lead\-generation techniques.
* Effectively communicate with prospective customers to understand their needs, answer inquiries, and provide information about our RV products and services.
* Utilize provided scripts and talking points for both initiating and receiving phone calls.
* Proactively make 8\-10 outbound calls per hour with the primary objective of scheduling sales appointments.
* Utilize the CRM system to record and manage customer information, appointments, calls, and sales interactions. Maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date data is essential for efficient follow\-up and tracking.
* Stay up\-to\-date with all ongoing marketing campaigns and promotions. Align your efforts with marketing initiatives to leverage their impact on lead generation and sales conversion.
* Regularly track and analyze your personal performance metrics, including appointments scheduled, calls made, sales achieved, and customer engagements.
* Be receptive to coaching and work closely with the Sales Development Manager to improve departmental success.
* Ensure complete customer satisfaction by helping to proactively manage online reputation through review sites and social media outlets.
* Collaborate with sales team to ensure total department symbiosis and ensure a seamless journey from initial contact to sale.
* VinSolutions experience is a huge plus!

**What You Need to Have for the Role:**

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Results driven and motivated for sales
* Excellent customer service
* Effectively manages responsibilities with time management to reach goals
* Ability to multi\-task while demonstrating strong organizational skills
* Has prior CRM experience and is very computer savvy
* Previous sales experience a plus
* May lift up to 25 lbs and/or move up to 50 lbs. with assistive devices

The pay range for this role considers several factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the factors stated. A reasonable estimate of the total annual compensation range (base pay \+ variable compensation earned) is $35,000 \- $55,000 or more. This is a variable pay role with uncapped variable pay.


In addition to competitive pay, we offer Paid Time Off, 401(k), an Employee Assistance Program, Good Sam Roadside Assistance, discounts, paid parental leave (if eligibility is met), Tuition Reimbursement (if eligibility is met), and on the job training opportunities. For more information please visit: www.mycampingworldbenefits.com

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**


**About Us:**  

Atlanta\-based Incident IQ is the leading workflow management platform built exclusively for K\-12 districts. Trusted by over 2,000 districts, Incident IQ powers mission\-critical services for more than 12 million students and educators nationwide. By connecting technology and operational workflows, Incident IQ enables schools to streamline processes, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: supporting students.


**Purpose:**  

Incident IQ is committed to creating a future where every K\-12 district operates with seamless efficiency. When operations are unified on a single platform, districts gain the clarity and control needed to build a stronger foundation for student success. We're focused on delivering the tools, support, and partnerships that help make that vision a reality.


**Mission:**  

Incident IQ is on a mission to eliminate the friction of disconnected systems and clunky workflows that slow schools down. We're reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.

**Sales Development Representative Overview:**

  



Reporting directly to the Revenue Operations Leader, the Sales Development Representative SDR) will be responsible for generating interest and qualifying leads with target school districts within assigned territories.

  



The SDR will work actively with our field sales team to identify target school districts and implement outreach cadences to generate and qualify leads for our products. The GDR will also work extensively within our marketing automation and AI\-powered tools to identify, develop, and qualify leads for our field sales team. This role also manages and maintains our lead process protocols to ensure all qualified sales leads are properly distributed and tracked in our sales support systems.

  



Our Sales Development Team thrives on culture and collaboration, so working together 2\-3 days a week in one of our two offices \- Alpharetta and Atlanta \- is required.

  


**Sales Development Representative Responsibilities:**


* Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting
* Operate within RevOps at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, working inside a centrally coordinated outreach cadence that sequences prospect touches across Demand Gen, SDR, and Sales to prevent duplicate or conflicting outreach
* Design effective outbound prospecting sequences to effectively contact target school districts
* Engage and qualify prospects using agentic\-powered workflows, insights, and automated intelligence
* Utilize AI agents to research accounts, tailor messaging, and execute high\-quality outreach at scale, alongside core sales tech stack
* Activate demand by delivering personalized engagement across email, phone, social, and in\-product channels
* Partner with Demand Generation to act on campaign and account signals in real time, prioritizing outreach based on the most current marketing and sales intelligence available
* Carry and consistently deliver against a quota and activity metrics, tracked through Salesforce/Gong, and reported in a weekly goal\-setting and readout cadence
* Represent Incident IQ at industry conferences, trade shows, and marketing\-hosted events, including independently engaging prospects and conducting account drop\-ins as needed
* Work strategically with your field sales partner on a Go\-to\-Market strategy

  


**Sales Development Representative Requirements:**


* Four (4\) year college degree, or equivalent
* Experience or interest in working with AI\-powered sales engagement tools to improve prospecting efficiency and outreach quality
* Sales tech experience \- Primarily Salesforce, Gong, and Qualified to maximize performance and efficiency
* High energy, high activity personality and personal drive

 **What makes Incident IQ different:**


* We facilitate whole\-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone's opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K\-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices \- a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

  



Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid\-time off (PTO).

  




*Incident IQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

* Exhibits strong work ethic, takes initiative and can ‘read the room’ and adjust to the needs of the customer

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location**

GGP Chicago \- 350 N Orleans Street, Suite 300
**Business**

Headquartered in Chicago, IL, GGP is a leading retail real estate company with a portfolio of 95\+ high\-performing retail assets, encompassing over 95 million square feet of space across the United States. As an owner\-operator, we’re committed to creating vibrant destinations that bring people and brands together. With a team of 1,200\+ employees and a legacy of leadership in retail real estate, we’re shaping the future of the industry by delivering exceptional value to our partners and the communities we serve


If you’re ready to be a part of our team, we encourage you to apply.


**Job Description**

GGP has an immediate need for a **Marketing Coordinator** at our Chicago office.


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success, with a dotted line to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Marketing Coordinator is an hourly employee that serves as a vital resource for the Marketing team, providing tenant marketing coordination, marketing assistance, and administrative support.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Tenant Success support**
--------------------------


* Support the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success in the project management and implementation of prioritized tenant events and activations
* Coordinate the trafficking of retailer assets to support new store openings via digital channels across the portfolio
* Track all marketing, Strategic Partnership (GGP Media), and Property Management support for prioritized new store openings
* Assist with a variety of project management, event, and promotional program needs, including (but not limited to) developing sweepstakes rules with Legal as well as the sourcing and fulfillment of prizes or other event elements
* Develop and maintain the overall new store opening calendar and associated project plans and own overall successful execution of said plans

**Marketing support**
---------------------


* Manage budgeting tasks, including expense management, invoice processing, and monthly accruals for accounting
* Publish web and social content
* Collaborate with Legal and Risk Management on contractual agreements as needed
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Administrative for Head of Marketing**
----------------------------------------


* Assist in the daily business of department and team functions, such as coordinating meeting communication and flow, shipping and packaging, and assisting in team outings
* Support companywide cultural initiatives such as philanthropy events, monthly cultural programming, Leadership Conference, Town Halls, and Holiday Party
* Travel and expense management for Head of Marketing
* PowerPoint and QA support
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**
-------------


* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, real estate, hospitality, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

**Experience**
--------------


* Experience working in cross\-functional, stakeholder\-driven environments
* Experience with invoicing/contract management a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point)

**Skills**
----------


* Strong project management skills with strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong collaboration with a willingness to jump in and learn
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activations simultaneously
* Have the ability to wear multiple hats, roll up sleeves and demonstrate proactivity

**Physical Requirements \& Work Environment**
---------------------------------------------


* Standard business hours, Monday through Friday in\-office environment
* Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support business continuity during high\-volume tenant opening periods, activations, or time\-sensitive tenant needs

**Compensation**

* Salary type: Non\-Exempt
* Pay Frequency: Bi\-weekly
* Hourly Pay Range: $24\.00 \- $33\.65/hour
* Annual Bonus: 10%

**Benefit Information**

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, Dental and Vision beginning day 1
* 401(k) Company matching
* 401(k) Vests on Day 1
* Career development programs
* Charitable donation matching
* Generous paid time off (i.e., vacation, personal holidays, paid sick time)
* Paid Volunteer Hours
* Paid Parental Leave
* Family planning assistance including IVF, surrogacy, and adoption options
* Wellness and mental health resources
* Pet insurance offering
* Childcare Assistance
* Commuter benefits
* A culture on our values of Act with Integrity, Build Mutual Trust, Take Initiative and Win Together.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre\-screening will be contacted.
\#GGP

As the industry leader in water technology, we’re growing and need talented people like you to help us continue to protect the world’s most vital resource.

Using a consultative sales approach, you’ll build relationships with existing customers by executing system assurance programs that meet their key business needs. * The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments
* The ability to make an impact with a company that is passionate about your career development

As the Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, you will support our growing services practice **.** The Practice delivers focused Agentic Services with the client's chosen OpenAI technologies, bringing industry depth and technical rigor to every phase of their AI journey including ChatGPT Enterprise, domain\-based customer models, agentic workflows and frontier platforms as well as change management and cybersecurity.

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative for the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice team, you will be responsible for:

Initiate the development and execution of lead generation field events, collateral, case studies, videos, or white papers. Coordinate with account teams for follow\-ups and drive deal progression.
* **Partner across sales teams:** Engage with Deloitte internal sales teams to explore opportunities for cross\-sell/upsell across technologies, platforms, offerings (e.g. AI\&E, Human Capital, Customer etc.) and domains (Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, HR etc.). Demonstrate comprehensive Industry sales coverage by generating new leads for sales executives.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). The practice offers solution engineering, technical enablement, and domain expertise to help organizations and Deloitte practitioners achieve their goals with artificial intelligence. We deliver hands\-on technical training, custom AI solutions, reusable tools, accelerators, and industry\-focused knowledge to address real\-world challenges, equipping both clients and Deloitte professionals with best practices, practical guidance, and collaborative networks to identify valuable AI opportunities and drive measurable outcomes.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:

* Fluency in Cloud Analytics/Data Platforms and Agentic/AI technologies.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  

Preferred:
  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited school or university.
* Expert level understanding of Cloud marketplace and strong command on market messaging and presence for Cloud\-oriented professional services firms.
* Experience executing sales and capturing strategies and initiatives to transition underperforming IT organizations and programs to become customer\-centric and operate a service delivery model.
* Deep technical understanding of Cloud technologies e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI and other Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) as well as a demonstrated understanding of modern approaches to Cloud infrastructure, software development, and legacy systems modernization.
* Work with account and pursuit teams to architect large, complex capture efforts with teaming partners, staff, and practice leadership at all stages of the capture lifecycle.

new_jobs.description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world's most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50\+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.


The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028\. We're building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you're excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we'd love to meet you.

**About the role…**
-------------------


We're looking for a Business Development Representative who will both personally drive meaningful new pipeline *and* work with the broader team to level up how our entire outbound engine runs. This is a rare blend of individual contribution and process innovation.


You'll carry a personal pipeline target and partner closely across our sales and marketing teams. Together, you will own our top\-of\-funnel strategy and goals. Just as importantly, you'll partner to reinvent how we prospect — bringing an AI\-first mindset to sourcing, research, messaging, and workflow so that our small team punches well above its weight. This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing \& RevOps and is fully remote, if located in Austin \- we would expect you to come into our local coworking space 2 days a week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


This is the top of Archive's revenue engine. Every new logo we win — Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance — started with someone opening the door. That's this role.

* **Own the number.** You'll carry a personal pipeline generation target and be jointly accountable with the team for the net new number overall — forecasting opportunity creation, calling it accurately, and keeping the team on pace.
* **Build relationships with world\-class brands.** You'll research, account plan, and open opportunities with an elite list of household names. We value depth over breadth: roughly 30 accounts a quarter, worked properly, beats a thousand sprayed sequences.
* **Rebuild how we prospect, with AI.** This is the half of the job that compounds. You'll use AI and LLMs to redesign how we source, research, prioritize, personalize, and sequence — testing, iterating, and doubling down on what works. The goal isn't efficiency, it's leverage: a motion where you and the team put out the quality *and* the volume of a 3\+ person BDR team, without losing the craft that makes outreach actually convert.
* **Own the data and inform the stack.** Everything tracked, documented, and flowing cleanly between tools. You'll demo new tools and make the call on what we add, consolidate, or cut. There are more tools than ever before, but the real magic is in your ability to creatively leverage these tools and know when to just show up as a human.
* **Partner across the go\-to\-market team.** You'll work directly with the sales and marketing team as well as partnering with other teams across the org— refining the end\-to\-end sales process, building the prospecting workflow, and making sure the outreach engine is aimed at the right brands and capturing the right signals.
* **Build momentum.** You'll help shape our sales norms as the team grows, and take on — or invent — the projects that help Archive grow. It's normal to have never built a motion like this before, you won’t be building it alone and we care more that you want to.

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 1\-2\+ years of sales development / outbound experience
* You've personally been a top\-performing BDR/SDR and still love the craft of opening opportunities — you take pride in crafting campaigns and writing emails that convert.
* You have strong writing skills and can generate compelling, high\-converting sales emails.
* You’re collaborative and want to be part of an excellent team, hold yourself and others to high standards, and are looking for the right role to advance your career.
* You're AI\-native. You don't just use ChatGPT to draft emails — you think in systems, and you have a strong point of view on how AI can be woven through the entire outreach landscape to make a tiny team output like a much larger one. You're excited to dig deeper and learn how to optimize with AI.
* You're proficient with sales and automation tools like HubSpot and Apollo, and you believe in continuous process improvement.
* You have a competitive nature and a growth mindset, and are willing to do hard things, viewing challenges as opportunities for development. Presenting in front of executives, cold calling, knocking on doors, finding the right way to get in front of the right people.
* You're organized and data\-driven, comfortable owning a number.
* You care about sustainability and believe in the power of secondhand shopping to transform the industry.
* Ideally you are in Austin and excited to be in person in our coworking space 2\+ days a week.

**Bonus requirements**
----------------------

* Events experience (in\-person networking)
* Writing experience (blogs, content, etc)
